newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Broadcast Group to sell television stations.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Broadcast Group to sell television stations.

text.p: U.S. Broadcast Group said on Friday that it has elected to divest all of its broadcasting properties, consisting of television stations in seven markets.

The stations include: WMGC-TV/ABC/Binghamton, New York; WVNY-TV/ABC/Burlington, Vt.; KJAC-TV/NBC/Beaumont, Texas; KFDX-TV/NBC/Wichita Falls, Texas; KSNF-TV/NBC/Joplin, Mo.; WWCP-TV/FOX/Johnstown, Pa., and WATM-TV/ABC/Altoona, Pa.
U.S. Broadcast said it has retained Communications Equity Associates Inc as exclusive investment advisor to assist in the sale process.
The company expects to conclude the sale in the second quarter of 1997, U.S. Broadcast said.
